1.title: Pan and zoom around an infinite board

min_p.evidence: no --min-p on the command line: mlx-serve's own default applies

engine.evidence: mlx-serve has no server-side reasoning-effort setting (lib/runtime/server-mlxserve.sh)

client.evidence: pi runs without --thinking and sends no reasoning effort (clients.py)

effective.evidence: neither the engine's command line nor the client sets an effort: mlx-serve renders a request that names no effort by its template's rule; lib/runtime/server-mlxserve.sh reads that as 'low' on Qwen3.8 (chat.zig), unverified here. Engine: mlx-serve has no server-side reasoning-effort setting (lib/runtime/server-mlxserve.sh). Client: pi runs without --thinking and sends no reasoning effort (clients.py)

gaps: reasoning effort: 'low' requested, neither the engine nor the client applies one
